Subject: Private Offer: ask for first-year commission carve-out + Net60

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited about the latency/cost profile for the inference tier we discussed. We are preparing a Private Offer on AWS and have two asks from procurement before we proceed:

- Request a commission carve-out on the Marketplace listing for the first 12 months (Storakinetics has a large initial usage ramp and wants to route purchases through their PO flow without Marketplace fees applied on month 1–12).
- Billing window: procurement insists on Net60 rather than Net30.

They've asked whether Redwood can accept Net60 if we also agree to the carve-out. From our side, they are offering a 3-year committed usage profile and a co-marketing dollar commitment in year one.

Can you outline what approvals we'd need and a fast timeline? Procurement would like to lock this in by the end of next week so they can submit the private offer to AWS. Please loop in finance/legal as needed.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Desai
Head of Cloud Ops | StoraKinetics

Short answer: this is an exceptions request and will need expedited signoff from finance and our marketplace deal desk. To move fast I need the following from you by end of day Tuesday:

- Formal PO or LOI showing the 3-year committed units and the expected first-year consumption (absolute $ committed).
- Confirmation of the co-marketing dollar amount and timing (to be included in the commercial offset).
- Confirmation that StoraKinetics will accept a small implementation SLA margin for go-live (we prefer to limit carveouts that materially affect our break-even in the ramp months).

From Redwood's side, here is the approval path I will trigger today: finance (Marissa) -> marketplaces lead (Ben) -> legal final redlines. 1) Expected billings by month for months 1–12 (absolute $; include committed minimums).
2) The proposed commercial structure: carve-out specifics (no marketplace commission v. reduced commission), any clawback language, and the co-marketing credit schedule.
3) Payment mechanics: PO + Net60 full term or a hybrid (e.g., 30% upfront / rest Net60).
4) Proposed contract term and whether Redwood holds any termination rights tied to usage minimums.

Marissa — thanks, attaching the populated workbook and a short summary below. Also linking the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-42251

Summary (numbers are first-year outlook):
- First-year committed billings: $4.5M (expected consumption ramp months 1–6).
- Proposed carve-out ask: 0% marketplace commission months 1–12 (StoraKinetics asks for full carve-out).
- Co-marketing: $150k co-funded in first 6 months, tied to joint GTM events.
- Payment request: Net60 on monthly invoices; procurement will provide a PO and 30% of year-1 committed spend as a refundable deposit within 45 days.
- Term: 3 years with usage minimums; Redwood would retain right to convert the listing to standard commission structure if monthly actuals fall below 40% of committed in any trailing 3-month window.

Attachments: storakinetics_ma_revenue_model.xlsx, storakinetics_po_template.pdf

As discussed, finance signoff here would let us accept Net60 with the PO + refundable deposit. If we need to shorten the carve-out period (e.g., carve-out months 1–6 only), please advise and we'll model alternatives in the shared sheet.

Karthik / Samir — after reviewing the workbook and speaking with marketplaces, we can approve an exception with the following conditions:

1) Commission carve-out for months 1–6 only (not 12). Months 7–36 revert to a 15% marketplace commission.
2) StoraKinetics must provide the PO and post the refundable deposit equal to 30% of year-1 committed spend within 45 days of signing; Redwood to invoice monthly with Net60 payment terms thereafter.
3) Co-marketing funds ($150k) will be deducted from any uplift credit applied to the first 12 months; schedule to be in the SOW.
4) Add a clawback clause: if actuals are <50% of committed across months 1–6, Redwood may recoup the carve-out value as an overage charge in months 7–9.
5) Legal to review a short amendment to the Marketplace Private Offer (Ben/Legal) — please allow 48 hours for redlines.

Once Legal confirms the language, finance will sign the internal approval form. Ben — please confirm you can update the Marketplace listing and coordinate with AWS contacts (Angela Wu) to ensure the private offer reflects the carve-out period.
